questions.title: Algorithm Complexity Analysis
questions.description: What is the time complexity of the following operations on a balanced binary search tree of n elements?

options.text: Search: O(n), Insert: O(n), Delete: O(n)
Search: O(log n), Insert: O(log n), Delete: O(log n)
Search: O(1), Insert: O(1), Delete: O(1)
Search: O(log n), Insert: O(1), Delete: O(n)

questions.explanation: Balanced BST maintains O(log n) for all basic operations due to its height being log n.

questions.title: Recursion Concepts
questions.text_with_blanks: A recursive function must have a _____ case to prevent infinite recursion. The recursive case should make progress toward the _____ case. Each recursive call creates a new _____ frame.
questions.explanation: Base case stops recursion, progress ensures termination, stack frames manage calls.
